newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann in wheels deal with Michelin.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann in wheels deal with Michelin.

text.p: Mannesmann AG of Germany said on Tuesday it had reached fundamental agreement to team up with Groupe Michelin to make car wheels, and will sell 51 percent of Kronprinz AG to the French company.

The agreement is still subject to the approval of cartel authorities. Kronprinz AG had sales of 290 million marks ($174 million) in 1996, while Michelin's output of steel and aluminium wheels in France and Spain was worth 300 million marks, Mannesmann said. ($ = 1.666 German Marks)
"The cooperation will make it possible to offer customers a wider range of products and service, efficiently supplying all sectors of the market," Mannesmann said in a statement.
Kronprinz AG, which is based in Solingen, employs around 1,200 workers.
No terms for the transaction were given in the statement.
